name: Cyril Morlet
title: Senior Backend Engineer — TypeScript/Node.js · Trading & Chain Infrastructure · ex-Bitfinex
summary: Backend engineer with 12 years shipping production distributed systems, JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js at the core the whole way. At Bitfinex, a top-tier crypto trading exchange, I owned blockchain deposit/withdrawal pipelines: transaction processing across L1/L2s, reorg handling, finality thresholds, fee accounting — backend code where a bug loses customer funds. Since then I build and operate my own web3 platform: ~600K lines, wallet flows (zkLogin onboarding, sponsored transactions), a Rust chain indexer serving sub-second reads, and real-time services on Redis and WebSocket. Reliability is the discipline I optimize for.
